input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision in the Agreement. Renewal is automatic for successive one-year periods, which satisfies the 12-month renewal-term requirement, but the notice needed to stop a renewal is ninety (90) days — above the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window and at the walk-away boundary — so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. Renewal carries no price-uplift mechanic: the fee stays fixed at 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month (Section 3.1, p0019), so the 5% cap element is satisfied by inapplicability. Our edit therefore does one thing: it sets the Company's non-renewal notice window at 60 days (stated as "60 days" so the window is unambiguous), landing the clause at the fallback, while leaving HDI's own exit notice at ninety (90) days so we retain transition runway. The preferred mechanics that remain absent (30-day opt-out, HDI reminder 60 days before renewal, and the resulting mutual-written-agreement default, plus a lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap) are gaps short of preferred wording, not separate deviations; the Section 4.2 Termination Payment sits under the termination-for-convenience rule.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.summary: Cut the Company's non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 to 60 days while leaving HDI's exit notice at 90 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We reduced the notice the Company must give to stop an automatic renewal to 60 days, which is our fallback position (preferred is 30 days plus an HDI reminder 60 days before renewal), and left HDI's own exit notice at 90 days so we keep transition runway. The one-year renewal term and the fixed fee in Section 3.1 (no renewal uplift) are acceptable as drafted.

ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon 60 days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice.
